summary: Completed comprehensive testing of E4N (Exchange for Necessities) platform - backend APIs and frontend UI functionality

ui_bugs.issue: Order form input fields (quantity, price) not easily selectable with standard selectors
Some interactive elements like bet buttons and action buttons not easily detectable with text selectors

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1, indicating potential responsive design issues

passed_tests: All 29 backend API endpoints working correctly (100% success rate)
Authentication flow for all user roles (retail, institutional, farmer, regulator)
Dashboard page loads with portfolio stats, market data, and charts
Trading page displays asset tabs, price charts, order book, and recent trades
Carbon Credits page shows comprehensive stats, charts, and project table
Portfolio page displays holdings and recent trades
Compliance page shows region-based rules with severity indicators
Predictions page displays market cards with probability bars
Admin dashboard accessible for regulator role with system overview
Navigation between all pages working correctly
JWT authentication with Bearer tokens and httpOnly cookies
Role-based access control (regulator can access admin features)
Glass morphism dark UI theme implemented correctly
